title: no right that needs a registry act is claimed — a machine-checked theorem of the ℤ/9 vortex deposit
description:
no right that needs a registry act is claimed, declared in src/proof/rights.lean and accepted by the Lean 4 kernel, sorry-free and axiom-free, closing by by decide.

Statement (Lean):

(instruments.filter (fun r => kindOf r == 1)).all (fun r => claim r == false)

Statement (LaTeX):

\forall r \in \{\, r \in \mathrm{instruments} \mid \mathrm{kindOf}\mathopen{}\left(r\right) = 1 \,\},\; \mathrm{claim}\mathopen{}\left(r\right) = \mathrm{false}

What this record establishes. A dated, public, citable deposit of this declaration and its proof, recomputable from the source it names. That is priority. It is not a claim that the result is unknown to the literature: prior art for this file is recorded in src/proof/priorart.lean as unclassified — no prior-art search has been performed, so no novelty is asserted.

Scope. The declaration is decided over a finite domain by exhaustion. It settles no Clay Millennium Problem and claims no quantum speedup. 0/7.
